name: admin
description: Manages every resource on the platform, including full control over users and roles. Assign to the one or two people responsible for platform setup and for managing accounts and roles.

name: team_lead
description: Manages agents, gateways, and jobs, and views users, roles, and the audit log. Assign to whoever leads an engagement and is accountable for its agents, infrastructure, jobs, and team activity.

name: operator
description: Deploys and operates agents, runs and cancels jobs, reads job output, and views gateways. Assign to the people actively running the engagement by deploying agents and executing jobs; the default role for most of the team.

name: analyst
description: Views agents, gateways, jobs, and job output. Assign to people who follow and report on an engagement without executing anything, such as reporting staff, trainees, or blue-team observers.

name: auditor
description: Views every resource, including users, roles, and the audit log. Assign to oversight or compliance reviewers who need full visibility across the platform but take no operational action.
